mostWorthwhile.text: Supplying oxygen to the mitochondrion was most worthwhile: the illustration plan connects electron transfer, the hydrogen-ion gradient and ATP synthesis rather than just labeling mitochondria as an energy source.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pump was clear but comparatively routine; its purpose became more interesting only when ATP powered transport.

surprise.text: The protein-making result explicitly separates pyruvate's fuel route from the amino acids used in the protein chain.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although choosing mitochondrial rather than cytosolic ATP was a preference for following the pathway, not a demonstrated requirement.

continue.text: Yes. I would try another chapter to see whether it builds similarly clear links between cellular structures and functions, though the compatible-option menu makes the choices fairly guided.
